const crypto=require('crypto'); const headers=$json.headers||{}; const raw=String($json.rawBody||''); const ts=String(headers['x-slack-request-timestamp']||''); const sig=String(headers['x-slack-signature']||''); const secret=String($env.SUPPORTPORTAL_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET||''); const age=Math.abs(Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)-Number(ts||0)); const expected='v0='+crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`v0:${ts}:${raw}`).digest('hex'); if(!secret||age>300||sig.length!==expected.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sig),Buffer.from(expected))) throw new Error('invalid_slack_signature');
const form=new URLSearchParams(raw); const p=JSON.parse(String(form.get('payload')||'{}')); const a=(p.actions||[])[0]||{}; let value={}; try{value=JSON.parse(String(a.value||'{}'));}catch{} const action=String(a.action_id||value.action||''); const interactionId=String(p.trigger_id||`${p.user?.id||''}:${a.action_ts||''}:${action}`); const eligible=String(p.team?.id||'')==='REPLACE_WITH_SLACK_TEAM_ID' && String(p.channel?.id||'')==='REPLACE_WITH_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID' && !!String(p.container?.thread_ts||'') && ['guardrail','final_approve'].includes(action) && !!String(p.user?.id||'') && !!String(value.investigation_id||'') && Number(value.draft_version)>0; return [{json:{eligible,interaction_id:interactionId,team_id:String(p.team?.id||''),channel_id:String(p.channel?.id||''),thread_ts:String(p.container?.thread_ts||''),slack_user_id:String(p.user?.id||''),action,investigation_id:String(value.investigation_id||''),draft_version:Number(value.draft_version||0),guardrail_id:value.guardrail_id||null,guardrail_version:value.guardrail_version||null}}];

parameters.query: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO public.n8n_supportportal_engineer_slack_inbound_events(inbound_id,inbound_kind,engineer_case_id,slack_user_id) VALUES ($1,'interaction',$2,$3) ON CONFLICT(inbound_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING engineer_case_id) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT engineer_case_id FROM inserted),'') engineer_case_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) forward;
